# Load Libraries

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: true

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(pheatmap)
```

# Data Upload

```{r}

# the list used passed QC
sample_list <- here("results_for_analysis",
                    "sample_list_QC_passed.txt")

sample_list <- readLines(sample_list)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-virulencefinder

virulence_finder_path <- here("results_for_analysis",
                              "virulencefinder",
                              "virulencefinder_summary.xlsx")



virfinder_exoenzyme  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_exoenzyme_database")
virfinder_toxin  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_toxin_database")
virfinder_hostimm    <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "s.aureus_hostimm_database")
virfinder_overview  <- read_excel(virulence_finder_path, sheet = "Detailed_overview")
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview
```

```{r}
virfinder_overview <- virfinder_overview |>
  rename(
    sample              = `Sample`,
    hit_database        = `Hit database`,
    virulence_factor    = `Virulence factor`,
    identity            = `%Identity`,
    query_hsp_length    = `Query/HSP length`,
    contig              = `Contig`,
    position_in_contig  = `Position in contig`,
    protein_function    = `Protein function`,
    accession_number    = `Accession number`,
    coverage            = `Coverage`,
    hit_id              = `Hit ID`,
    position_in_reference = `Positions in reference`
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: virfinder-qc-filter

# QC thresholds
VIR_IDENTITY <- 90   # min %identity
VIR_COVERAGE <- 60   # min coverage %

vir_df <- virfinder_overview |>
  filter(!is.na(virulence_factor)) |>
  filter(sample %in% sample_list) |>
  filter(identity >= VIR_IDENTITY, coverage >= VIR_COVERAGE) |>
  group_by(sample, hit_database, virulence_factor) |>
  slice_max(identity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

cat("Total hits after QC:", nrow(vir_df), "\n")
count(vir_df, hit_database)
count(vir_df, virulence_factor, sort = TRUE) |> head(15)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-metadata

metadata <- read_tsv(
  here("results_for_analysis", "s_aureus_metadata.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  rename(
    sample         = `Sequence file name`,
    date           = `Date of isolation`,
    sample_type    = `Sample type`,
    host           = `Sample source`,
    region         = Region,
    animal_contact = `Human Contact with animals`,
    species        = Species,
    ST_meta        = ST
  )
```

```{r}
metadata
```

```{r}
#| label: load-mlst

mlst_df <- read_tsv(
  here("results_for_analysis", "mlst", "mlst_summary.txt"),
  col_names  = FALSE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

colnames(mlst_df) <- c("sample", "species", "ST",
                       "gene1", "gene2", "gene3",
                       "gene4", "gene5", "gene6", "gene7")

mlst_df <- mlst_df |>
  mutate(
    sample = sample |>
      str_remove("^.*/") |>     # strip any directory prefix
      str_remove("\\.fasta$")
  ) |>
  filter(sample %in% sample_list)

mlst_df |> count(ST, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-final-strain-data

meta_vs_mlst <- metadata |>
  left_join(mlst_df |> select(sample, ST_mlst = ST), by = "sample") |>
  mutate(
    ST_meta_clean = str_remove(ST_meta, "^ST") |> str_trim(),
    ST_meta_clean = case_when(
      ST_meta_clean == "Unknown" ~ NA_character_,
      ST_meta_clean == "Unkown"  ~ NA_character_,   # metadata typo
      TRUE                       ~ ST_meta_clean
    ),
    ST_mlst_clean = as.character(ST_mlst)
  ) |>
  filter(sample %in% sample_list)

# resolve final ST: MLST priority, metadata fallback
final_strain_data <- meta_vs_mlst |>
  mutate(ST_final = case_when(
    ST_mlst_clean != "-"      ~ ST_mlst_clean,
    !is.na(ST_meta_clean)     ~ ST_meta_clean
  )) |>
  select(-c(ST_meta, ST_meta_clean, ST_mlst_clean))

count(final_strain_data, ST_final, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
final_strain_data
```

```{r}
#| label: build-annotation

# row annotation: ST, host, region — ordered by ST then host
annot_row <- final_strain_data |>
  mutate(
    ST     = paste0("ST", ST_final),
    region = iconv(region, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  ) |>
  select(sample, ST, host, region) |>
  arrange(ST, host) |>
  column_to_rownames("sample")

# gap positions between ST groups
gap_pos <- annot_row |>
  mutate(row_n = row_number()) |>
  group_by(ST) |>
  summarise(last = max(row_n), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(last) |>
  pull(last) |>
  head(-1)

# color palette for STs (auto-scales to however many you have)
st_levels <- sort(unique(annot_row$ST))
st_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("#378ADD", "#fa0606", "#3B6D11", "#BA7517",
                     "#534AB7", "#0F6E56", "#993556", "#5F5E5A",
                     "#D85A30", "#185FA5"))(length(st_levels)),
  st_levels
)

ann_colors <- list(
  ST = st_cols,
  host = c(
    "Cow"   = "#a0d69c",
    "Human" = "#c9937b"
  ),
  region = c(
    "Bagamoyo" = "#EEEDFE",
    "Morogoro" = "#AFA9EC",
    "Tanga"    = "#7F77DD",
    "D'Salaam" = "#3C3489"
  )
)

# sanity
head(annot_row)
gap_pos
```

```{r}
#| label: vir-helper

build_identity_matrix <- function(long_df, db_name, all_samples, annot) {
  
  sub <- long_df |> filter(hit_database == db_name)
  
  # wide identity matrix: rows = samples, cols = genes
  mat <- sub |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = sample,
      names_from  = virulence_factor,
      values_from = identity
    )
  
  # add samples with no hits in this database
  missing <- setdiff(all_samples, mat$sample)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    mat <- bind_rows(mat, tibble(sample = missing))
  }
  
  mat <- mat |>
    column_to_rownames("sample") |>
    as.matrix()
  
  # match row order to annotation
  mat[rownames(annot), , drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: vir-matrices

mat_exo  <- build_identity_matrix(vir_df, "s.aureus_exoenzyme", sample_list, annot_row)
mat_tox  <- build_identity_matrix(vir_df, "s.aureus_toxin",     sample_list, annot_row)
mat_host <- build_identity_matrix(vir_df, "s.
                                  aureus_hostimm",   sample_list, annot_row)

cat("Exoenzyme: ", nrow(mat_exo),  "x", ncol(mat_exo),  "\n")
cat("Toxin:     ", nrow(mat_tox),  "x", ncol(mat_tox),  "\n")
cat("Hostimm:   ", nrow(mat_host), "x", ncol(mat_host), "\n")

# add ST152 highlight column to the annotation
annot_row_vir <- annot_row |>
  mutate(highlight = if_else(ST == "ST152", "ST152", "other"))

ann_colors_vir <- c(
  ann_colors,
  list(highlight = c("ST152" = "#ebf830", "other" = "white"))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: vir-heatmap_function

draw_vir_heatmap <- function(mat, title) {
  pheatmap(
    mat,
    annotation_row    = annot_row_vir,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors_vir,
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_cols      = FALSE,
    gaps_row          = gap_pos,
    color             = colorRampPalette(c("#cfe3f5", "#0a4d8c"))(50),
    na_col            = "white",
    border_color      = "grey90",
    cellwidth         = 30,
    cellheight        = 10,
    fontsize_row      = 7,
    fontsize_col      = 10,
    angle_col         = 45,
    legend            = TRUE,
    main              = title
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10
draw_vir_heatmap(mat_exo,  "Virulence: exoenzymes — S. aureus Tanzania (n=53)")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 10
draw_vir_heatmap(mat_tox,  "Virulence: toxins — S. aureus Tanzania (n=53)")
```
